Package aor.proj3t.resource

Class AuthResource

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.resource.AuthResource
@Path("/auth") @RequestScoped @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class AuthResource extends Object
REST endpoint for authentication-related operations.

This class is responsible for handling requests related to user authentication, including registration, login (with optional two-factor), logout, confirmation, and password reset. It delegates logic to service-layer components and ensures validation and security headers are respected.

      @POST @Path("/register") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response registerUser(LoginDTO loginDto)
      Registers a new user using credentials provided in the LoginDTO. Validates input and captures IP address for audit.
      Parameters:
      loginDto - the user credentials and email
      Returns:
      a response indicating successful registration

    • login

      @POST @Path("/login") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response login(LoginDTO loginDto)
      Authenticates a user using provided login credentials. Handles IP and User-Agent headers for session context.

      Returns:
      a response containing session or temporary token data
